# Smart Start City Guides

> Practical, print-ready A4 PDF guides for relocating to (Expat) and visiting (Travel) 11 European cities, published in English, German, Polish, and Bulgarian. Every guide includes a free 10-page starter PDF, a full 58-76 page edition, and a free deep-dive article.

- Storefront: https://smartstartpub.gumroad.com/
- Web Catalog: https://jchristov.github.io/smart-start-guides/
- Free Articles Library: https://jchristov.github.io/smart-start-guides/en/articles/
- Privacy Policy (GDPR): https://jchristov.github.io/smart-start-guides/privacy/
- RSS Feed (All Languages): https://jchristov.github.io/smart-start-guides/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://jchristov.github.io/smart-start-guides/sitemap.xml
